QuestInfo.name: [Solatum] The Truth of Solatum
QuestInfo.0: The fight is done...for now. You need to tell the others what happened here. Return to the Operations Center.
QuestInfo.1: Return to #bOperations Center#k and hear what Carlisle told Neinheart.
QuestInfo.2: #bThe Grand Master#k wanted to wipe out the Order and conceal the truth. A potential ally in Thenia has been lost, and a certain enemy in Bellona has been gained...
